description: The Qinling landslide mapping team publishes vector boundaries for 169,888 landslides in China through 4TU.ResearchData repository. Optical-image interpretation, literature and earlier research support the inventory. Version 1 states that only 2,000 boundaries have completed validation, with further checking planned. Shapefiles are provided in a RAR archive under CC0 for free reuse. The polygons can support infrastructure exposure overlays, land-use screening and landslide-model evaluation, provided that the distinction between mapped and checked features is retained. Observation dates and validation coverage are incomplete in the inspected metadata, and boundaries alone do not give event frequencies or runout probabilities. No directly related catalogue resource was found.
